paper_title: Advancing Globular Cluster Constraints on the Axion-Photon Coupling
suggested_experiment_name: Globular Cluster R₂ Parameter Constraint (Horizontal Branch / Asymptotic Giant Branch Ratio)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling
notes: Paper derives new stellar cooling bound on axion-photon coupling using R2 parameter (ratio of AGB to HB stars) in globular clusters. Main conservative constraint: g_agamma < 0.47 × 10^-10 GeV^-1 using semiconvection mixing scheme. Complementary asteroseismology evidence suggests potential improvement to g_agamma < 0.34 × 10^-10 GeV^-1 using predictive mixing, shown in pink in Fig. 1 but not adopted as final constraint due to uncertainties. The bound is mass-independent (valid for axion masses O(10^-6) to O(1) eV as stated in abstract and text), encoded as horizontal line.
